observations: A face fills most of the frame against a flat purple background; tangled orange, yellow, red, and white lines cover the upper head, while the lower face and shoulders are blocked in solid black.
Two eyes with green irises and heavy black lash marks sit near center; the mouth is open with a visible row of white teeth and red interior, framed by dark lines that pull the lip edges back.
A dense scribble layer—black, white, teal, and pink lines—runs across the cheeks and forehead, sitting visibly on top of the yellow-gold base color rather than blending into it.
reading: Gold and orange scribble fills the upper skull while solid black anchors the shoulders, splitting the figure into warm chaos above and cool weight below. Green irises and bared teeth carry a reading of high tension—rage, fear, or something unresolved. The scribble layer over the skin gives the surface a frayed quality, lines resting on top rather than settling in. The flat purple field holds the face at a cool distance.
